name: Windsurf
short: Windsurf, the AI-first code editor (now Devin Desktop by Cognition). Its Cascade agent runs in-editor and routes each prompt to a model you pick from a dropdown: Cognition's in-house SWE family plus third-party frontier and open-source models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi). Usage draws down your plan quota and extra usage bills at API pricing.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Light daily/weekly quota; model availability limited to the in-house SWE-1.6; unlimited inline edits and unlimited Tab completions.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Increased quota plus full model availability (frontier OpenAI, Anthropic, Google + leading open-source). SWE-2 free on self-serve through Nov 30, 2026; beyond quota you buy extra usage at API pricing.

plans.name: Max
plans.notes: Everything in Pro with significantly higher quotas, for heavy agent use.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: Up to 200 users, shared collaboration, admin dashboard, centralized billing.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: VPC deployment, SAML/OIDC SSO, centralized admin controls, dedicated account team; billed in Agent Compute Units.
